full_judgment: Latifur Rahman J: The plaintiff-respondent's Family Suit No. 250 of 1994 for guardianship and custody of her minor twin sons has been decreed by the Assistant Judge, 6th Court and Judge of the Family Court, Dhaka on 9-4-95, giving custody of the twin sons to the plaintiff. Against the judgment and decree the defendant preferred Family Appeal No. 10 of 1955. The Additional District Judge, 7th Court, Dhaka allowed the appeal and set aside the judgment of the Family Court directing the custody of the minors to the defendant-father. Against the said judgment and decree the plaintiff preferred Civil Revision No. 3692 of 1995. A learned Single Judge of the High Court Division by his judgment and order dated 10-12-97 made the Rule absolute after setting aside the judgment and order of the lower appellate Court and restored those of the trial Court .
